title_text: A HAUNTING ON WASHINGTON AVENUE THE TEMPLE THEATRE
other_text: PERHAPS THE WANDERING LOST SOULS OF OLD SACINAW CITY ARE DRAWN TO THIS FAMILIAR LANDMARK MUCH LIKE MOTHS TO A FLAME. THE FLASHING LIGHTS AND ANTIQUE GLOW GUIDING THEIR WAY. - STEVEN T. SHIPPY, NATIONAL RECORDING ARTIST AND FILM DIRECTOR
description: Poster shows an old theater marquee reading "Temple on Washington Avenue" with dim lighting and a quote about haunting souls.
